name: adibirzu-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by adibirzu for production engineering, gated delivery workflows, CI/CD hardening, multi-model routing, and OCI cloud operations

plugins.name: prod-ready
plugins.description: Pre-production security audit, dependency hardening, CI/CD validation, and Docker readiness checks for Claude Code

plugins.name: rlm
plugins.description: Budgeted recursive analysis for large repositories and document sets with evidence ledgers, selective verification, and safe capability fallbacks

plugins.name: multillm
plugins.description: Route Claude Code to 19 LLM backends (local, cloud, OCI GenAI, CLI agents incl. Claude Code/Codex/Gemini/Antigravity) through one gateway. Cost prediction, budgets, quota-aware failover, model fusion (panel+judge), log-driven routing, council/2nd-opinion, shared memory, and a real-time dashboard - all local, tenancy-agnostic. Bring your own keys/env. Runs a SessionStart hook that installs and starts a local gateway: read SECURITY.md before installing.

plugins.name: oci-administrator
plugins.description: OCI Skills v2 provides 24 safety-first skills for administration, Terraform, platform engineering, storage, disaster recovery, Bastion, database-cloud, landing-zone, and application workflows. Named contexts, preflight receipts, redaction, and risk-specific approval protect live actions.

plugins.name: just-do-it
plugins.description: Turn one goal into reviewed PRDs and clean least-privilege agent teams across Codex, Claude, AGY, Cursor, Grok, Pi, and Cline.

plugins.name: oci-observability-tools
plugins.description: Offline OCI Observability and Management skills and validators. Independent community project, not an Oracle product and not endorsed or supported by Oracle.

plugins.name: poteto-workflow
plugins.description: Gated engineering workflow: interrogate, arena, swarm and show-me-your-work, held to seven crew gates (failing test first, cross-family review, gitleaks scans, full suite green, owner-approved merges, no AI co-author trailers, tiered model routing).

plugins.name: coding-cicd-hardening
plugins.description: Secure coding and CI/CD baseline: SHA-pinned actions, OIDC instead of static keys, least-privilege tokens, CycloneDX 1.7 and SPDX 2.3 SBOMs, gitleaks, SAST, Dependabot, test isolation, plus a standard-library workflow linter and SBOM generator.
